title_original: GXO and Agility Robotics Expand Partnership to Accelerate Deployment of Humanoids in U.S. Operations
title_zh: GXO 与 Agility 扩大 Digit 仓储机器人协议，新增两处美国站点
title_en: GXO and Agility agree to extend Digit to two additional U.S. sites
summary_zh: GXO 与 Agility 公告，Digit 将进入北卡罗来纳州 Statesville 和田纳西州 Lebanon 的 GXO 站点，预计 2027 年初开始部署 Digit 4，随后转向 Digit 5。GXO 表示其佐治亚州站点自 2024 年商业协议以来已搬运超过 10 万个料箱；新站点的实际运行尚待观察。
summary_en: GXO and Agility agreed to add Digit to GXO sites in Statesville, North Carolina, and Lebanon, Tennessee. Deployments are expected to start with Digit 4 in early 2027 and later transition to Digit 5. GXO reports more than 100,000 totes moved at its Georgia site since the 2024 commercial agreement; operation at the new sites has yet to begin.
why_it_matters_zh: 由现有客户宣布跨站点扩展，为人形机器人在仓储任务中的商业复用提供后续观察点。
limitations_zh: 新站点是协议和计划，尚非已完成部署；料箱数量为合作双方披露，未见独立审计。
claim_evidence_notes: GXO/Agility joint announcement Oct 26, paragraphs on two new sites and 2027 schedule. Two parties jointly claim 100,000 totes at existing site; no third-party audit found.

title_original: フィジカルAIを推進する新会社「ELYZA Robotics」事業開始
title_zh: KDDI 公布 ELYZA Robotics 业务及机器人研发投入计划
title_en: KDDI announces ELYZA Robotics and its physical AI investment plan
summary_zh: KDDI 与 ELYZA 于 10 月 27 日首次公告，新公司 ELYZA Robotics 已在 10 月 1 日开展业务。KDDI 计划到 2030 财年为物理 AI 研发投入 300 亿日元、组建 300 人以上团队，并以部署超过 1000 台机器人为目标；均属于未来计划，公告未给出已部署数量。
summary_en: KDDI and ELYZA announced on October 27 that ELYZA Robotics had begun operations on October 1. KDDI plans to invest ¥30 billion in physical AI R&D and build a team of more than 300 by fiscal 2030, targeting deployment of more than 1,000 robots. These are future targets; the release does not report deployments already achieved.
why_it_matters_zh: 把模型研发、硬件和现场部署放在同一业务计划中，值得持续追踪实际产品与部署进展。
limitations_zh: 公告日晚于业务开始日；投资、团队和部署数字均为未来目标，未披露已投入或已部署规模。
claim_evidence_notes: KDDI release dated Oct 27 JST; body explicitly says business began Oct 1. Entry covers announcement of plan, not Oct 1 start as a new event. ¥30bn, >300 and >1000 by FY2030 are targets.

title_original: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
title_zh: DeepMind 公布 Genie 4 世界模拟研究预览，提及机器人训练用途
title_en: DeepMind previews Genie 4 world simulation and potential robotics use
summary_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 世界模拟研究预览，向受信任测试者开放，并称正在探索与 Gemini Robotics 结合。公司提出将生成式交互环境用于机器人和智能体训练，但公告未提供机器人策略训练、迁移或实机收益的验证结果。
summary_en: Google DeepMind released Genie 4 as a research preview for trusted testers and says it is exploring its combination with Gemini Robotics. The company presents generated interactive worlds as a potential environment for robot and agent training, without reporting validated robot policy transfer or hardware gains.
why_it_matters_zh: 可交互世界模拟若能与物理任务相符，可能扩展训练环境；当前仍需验证物理一致性与迁移效果。
limitations_zh: 预览访问受限；机器人训练价值为潜在用途，尚无公开实机对照结果。
claim_evidence_notes: DeepMind Oct 27 blog says trusted-tester preview and experimentation with Gemini Robotics; no robot benchmark or sim-to-real data in article.

title_original: ARX Robotics and ROBONEERS achieve interoperability of ROBONEERS' SABER combat module with GEREON UGV platform
title_zh: ARX 与 ROBONEERS 宣称完成 GEREON 地面平台与 SABER 模块初步集成测试
title_en: ARX and ROBONEERS report initial GEREON–SABER integration tests
summary_zh: ARX Robotics 10 月 29 日称，与 ROBONEERS 完成 SABER 模块和 GEREON 无人地面平台的初步集成测试；两家公司计划年底前完成 M2 与 MK 19 (M) 配置集成。公告未提供测试协议、连续可靠性数据或本组合的已交付记录。
summary_en: ARX Robotics says it and ROBONEERS completed initial integration tests of the SABER module with the GEREON uncrewed ground platform. The companies plan to integrate M2 and MK 19 (M) configurations by year-end. The release provides no test protocol, reliability data, or deliveries of the combined system.
why_it_matters_zh: 模块化地面平台的互操作性是特种机器人系统集成的重要进展。
limitations_zh: 仅有公司单方公告；初步集成测试不等于完成作战部署。
claim_evidence_notes: ARX News Oct 29 article states initial integration testing and year-end plan. No independently accessible test report or customer confirmation of combined system.

title_original: Luxonis: New Silver OSRA Member and a New Product Release
title_zh: Luxonis 发布 OAK 4 FFC 多摄像头视觉计算板
title_en: Luxonis releases the OAK 4 FFC multi-camera vision computer
summary_zh: Open Robotics 联盟 10 月 27 日公告 Luxonis 发布 OAK 4 FFC，并升级为 OSRA Silver 会员。官方称该 70 × 53 毫米板卡可连接最多五个摄像头，处理同步、深度和设备端 AI；产品页和参考设计已公开，实际机器人应用性能仍需单独测试。
summary_en: The Open Robotics Alliance announced on October 27 that Luxonis released OAK 4 FFC and upgraded to OSRA Silver membership. It says the 70 × 53 mm board supports up to five cameras for synchronization, depth and on-device AI. The product page and reference design are available; performance in specific robots still needs testing.
why_it_matters_zh: 为多视角机器人感知系统提供紧凑的集成硬件选项。
limitations_zh: 规格来自发布方；未见第三方对延迟、功耗或复杂场景精度的测试。
claim_evidence_notes: OSRA announcement Oct 27 says released today, 70x53 mm, up to five cameras, links manufacturer page and reference design. Timezone not shown, retained date precision.

title_original: Rendezvous Robotics Raises $20 Million to Build Spacecraft That Assemble Themselves in Orbit
title_zh: Rendezvous Robotics 宣布获 2000 万美元种子轮，用于在轨自主组装飞行演示
title_en: Rendezvous Robotics announces $20 million seed round for orbital self-assembly
summary_zh: Rendezvous Robotics 10 月 28 日宣布完成由 MaC Venture Capital 和 Toyota Ventures 领投的 2000 万美元种子轮。公司正地面测试可自主移动、对准和连接的模块化航天器单元，并计划 2028 年开展七块单元的自由飞行组装与重新配置演示；该任务尚未在轨完成。
summary_en: Rendezvous Robotics announced a $20 million seed round led by MaC Venture Capital and Toyota Ventures. It is ground-testing modular spacecraft tiles for autonomous movement, alignment and connection, and plans a seven-tile free-flight assembly and reconfiguration demonstration in 2028. The orbital mission has not occurred.
why_it_matters_zh: 资金支持空间自主组装从受控演示向自由飞行验证迈进。
limitations_zh: 融资与时间表来自公司公告；2028 年任务属于计划，不能视为已验证的在轨能力。
claim_evidence_notes: Company announcement Oct 28 specifies $20m, lead investors, ground demos, seven tiles and 2028 target. Earlier TESSERAE controlled microgravity work is distinct from planned free flight.

entities: 湖南省工业和信息化厅
title_original: 聚焦真实场景实操 “湘工信杯”人形机器人大赛复赛开赛
title_zh: 湖南“湘工信杯”人形机器人复赛采用线下实操评测
title_en: Hunan humanoid robotics semifinal uses on-site practical tasks
summary_zh: 湖南省工信厅公告，10 月 27 日复赛在长沙举行，近 100 支队伍参与线下实操，考察工程落地能力、整机稳定性和任务完成质量，专家按赛道规则评分。公开公告没有给出具体任务、成绩分布或可复用评测数据。
summary_en: Hunan's industry department said the competition semifinal took place in Changsha on October 27, with nearly 100 teams performing on-site tasks. Judges scored system stability and task completion by track rules. The public notice does not provide task details, score distributions or reusable benchmark data.
why_it_matters_zh: 为人形机器人提供面向实际场景的现场评测活动，但技术结论需等待公开结果。
limitations_zh: 未披露任务明细和成绩，不能据比赛举办推断机器人已达到商业部署水平。
claim_evidence_notes: Provincial government notice at 2026-10-27 19:12 Beijing; nearly 100 teams, on-site practice and independent scoring. No public benchmark results in notice.

title_original: Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI Announce Expected Gross Capital Raise of Approximately $465 Million and Anticipated Closing of Business Combination
title_zh: Agility 与 Churchill XI 预计交易相关融资总额约 4.65 亿美元
title_en: Agility and Churchill XI expect about $465 million in gross transaction proceeds
summary_zh: 双方 10 月 30 日公告，拟议业务合并及配套融资的预计总筹资约 4.65 亿美元，包含信托账户约 1.64 亿、PIPE 承诺约 2.01 亿和此前已收到的 1 亿美元。交易仍须股东批准和满足交割条件，预计于 11 月 4 日完成；数字为交割前预计值，不是已实现营收。
summary_en: Agility and Churchill XI said on October 30 that expected gross proceeds from the proposed combination and related financing were about $465 million: roughly $164 million from the trust, $201 million of PIPE commitments and $100 million already received. Closing remained subject to shareholder approval and other conditions, with November 4 targeted. The figure is projected transaction funding, not earned revenue.
why_it_matters_zh: 潜在融资影响人形机器人产能和客户扩展，但须与实际交割及运营收入区分。
limitations_zh: 公告时交易尚未交割；本条不将预期融资或订单承诺计为已到账收入。
claim_evidence_notes: Oct 30 joint announcement: estimated $465m gross proceeds; Nov 2 shareholder vote, Nov 4 expected close. This is distinct financing event from Oct 26 GXO site expansion.
